title: cbuild_settings
description: The shop's settings, stored in the cbuild_settings option. What WooCommerce > Settings > Builder saves is checked against this.

attribute_mapping.description: Which product attribute feeds which spec, and the unit its values are written in.

attribute.description: A taxonomy such as pa_width, or the name of a product's own attribute.

spec.description: The spec key the attribute feeds.

unit.description: The unit an unmarked value is in, for a measure. Empty is the spec's own.

source_order.description: Which source wins where two say different things of one spec. First wins; each source once.
